description: This PHP source file contains a unit test class AbstractEndpointTest that verifies the behavior of an abstract API endpoint class within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on request parameter validation, sorting, pagination, and method invocations. It tests various aspects of the Endpoint class, including setting and retrieving request parameters, validation rules, and exception handling.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior and validation logic of API endpoint methods in the OrangeHRM system, including parameter rules, request setting, and exception handling.

methods.name: testEndpoint
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of request, request parameters, and validation decorator from the Endpoint mock object.

methods.name: testGetSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Validates that the method getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules returns the correct number of ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Helper method to invoke protected method 'getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules' on the Endpoint class.

methods.name: testSortOrderParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the 'sortOrder' parameter accepting 'ASC' and 'DESC', and exception on invalid input.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRules
methods.description: Validates that the 'limit' parameter accepts null, zero, positive integers, and string equivalents, but raises exception on invalid input.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Provides data-driven tests to ensure invalid 'limit' values trigger exceptions.

methods.name: limitParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider yielding invalid 'limit' values for exception testing.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the 'offset' parameter similar to 'limit'.

methods.name: testOffsetParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Provides data-driven tests for invalid 'offset' values to check for exceptions.

methods.name: offsetParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider with invalid 'offset' values for exception testing.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRules
methods.description: Validates 'sortField' parameter with acceptable values and empty string.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Runs tests that invalid 'sortField' values raise exceptions.

methods.name: sortFieldParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid 'sortField' values for exception assertions.

methods.name: testSetRequestParams
methods.description: Checks that 'setRequestParams' correctly assigns a RequestParams object to the Endpoint.

methods.name: testSetSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Verifies that parameters from query arrays are correctly mapped to FilterParams attributes, with optional default sort field.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParamsDataProvider
methods.description: Data provider with various query parameters to test parameter setting logic.

methods.name: getMockEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a mock Endpoint object with specified query parameters for testing.
